lastCompletedAssignment.assignment: Deploy verification and build stamping, plus the database script and table audit
lastCompletedAssignment.acceptance: No workbook and no independent review; merged and deployed at the owner's direct instruction during a live session.
lastCompletedAssignment.notes: Closed #740, #726, #739 and #736. A green deploy now has to prove the new build is running: the API is stamped with its commit after upload, each static build writes dist/version.json, and every deploy job polls until the app reports that commit, restarts once, then fails. Also fixed deploy-dev.yml classifying only the last commit of a push, which shipped nothing on c4f40200 and reported success. Deployed and verified: 5/5 apps serving 1eb4cfdd, no restart escalation. Opened #744 (retire dbo.MenuItems, still wired to the POS sync), #745 (test-created rows in the dev database), #746 (every /pair visit registers a new screen). Audit: docs/reports/database-schema-audit-2026-08-20.md - no table or script was removed, and the report says why.
